desc: Abel Tasman National Park is a world national parks located in New Zealand with 2253.0 km², est. 1942.

Akagera National Park is a protected area in eastern Rwanda covering 1,122 km² along the international border with Tanzania. It was founded in 1934 and includes savannah, montane and swamp habitats. The park is named for the Kagera River which flows along its eastern boundary feeding into Lake Ihema
